ios.desc:
Dwellable makes home maintenance simple. Get personalized reminders, smart checklists, and an AI assistant that knows your property—so you always know exactly what your home needs and when. Whether you're winterizing, changing HVAC filters, or staying ahead of seasonal tasks, Dwellable helps you take care of your home with confidence.

**Ask Dwellable Anything**
Your AI home assistant knows your specific property. Get instant answers, troubleshoot problems, and see what's worth upgrading—tailored to your home, not generic advice.

**Find Trusted Local Pros**
Need a hand? Dwellable finds reputable local contractors and service providers near you, complete with ratings and reviews—right when you need them.

**Smart Property Analysis**
Enter your address and Dwellable automatically pulls public property data to generate insights about your home's age, features, and maintenance needs.

**Intelligent Reminders**
Get timely push notifications for important maintenance tasks, based on your local climate and your home's unique details.

**Suggested Tasks & Home Checklists**
Dwellable recommends common upkeep tasks so you can build a personalized checklist for your home in seconds.

**Notebook**
Save notes, track repairs, plan projects, and organize ideas for any part of your home. Add text, checklists, and photos to keep everything in one place.

**Local**
Stay on top of local updates that affect your home—trash and recycling changes, road work, and municipal news for your area.

**Weekly Property Articles**
Every Friday, receive property-specific content: seasonal checklists, expert maintenance tips, market updates, and improvement ideas based on your home profile.

Dwellable brings everything you need for simple, proactive homeownership into one easy-to-use app—helping you stay organized and prevent costly repairs.

See EULA at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Dwellable – The app I built after waiving home inspection during Covid

quotes.text:
When my wife and I bought our first home in 2020, it was peak COVID. Our agent actually asked us to waive the home inspection, which was terrifying. I ended up walking through the house myself with a set of handwritten notes: “check if Kitchen outlets are GFI,” “make sure toilet flushes”, “test the bath fan”, etc.

That experience became the seed for Dwellable, a home maintenance and inspection app for homeowners like us who didn’t know where to start (both before and after buying).

The app automatically pulls your property records (square footage, year built, fuel type, etc.) and uses AI to recommend reminders and seasonal maintenance tasks. It’s free right now, built entirely native on iOS and Android.

On the side, I’ve been experimenting with VLMs (vision language models) to analyze photos that users take during inspections, for things like spotting corrosion or damaged caulking.

If you’ve ever felt lost after closing on a house, this might resonate.

Tech stack:

- Backend: Python + gRPC, RabbitMQ

- AI: Perplexity + OpenAI

- iOS: SwiftUI

- Android: Fully compose

Would love feedback!
